pages.observations: Definition integrates mechanical, electrical and software components, reprogrammability and optional human intervention. Robotics is design/programming/control. Slavic work/drudgery etymology and Capek R.U.R.1920 are stated.

Slide explicitly states1962, Unimation USA, Engelberger/Devol and GM. Unimate drawing labels rotary, vertical and radial motions and wrist bend/yaw/swivel. Vertical motion is depicted with a rotational arrow, not an automatic sliding-joint inference.
Mobility is transport; manipulation acts on the environment.
Wheels/flat surfaces shown with ROBOTINO; walking/running with one or more legs handles uneven terrain and BIGDOG image.
Medical teleoperation; painting coverage/path-planning issues; industrial teleoperated and autonomous modes. Arm photo is labeled KUKA-KR5.

questionCoverage.note: The brand caption only identifies an illustrative industrial arm; no separate technical behavior is established by memorizing the model name.

pages.observations: Five dimensions: fixed/mobile, serial/parallel, DOF, rigid/flexible and control. Older industrial robots fixed links/actuated joints. Modern movement includes factory/uneven terrain, walking, swimming and flying.

Serial PUMA560 has waist, shoulder, forearm and three wrist rotations ending at tool. Parallel platform has multiple loops, top spherical joints, extensible/prismatic legs, base U joints and axial actuator arrows. No natural end-effector caption is not a tool prohibition.
Full arbitrary3D task6DOF; painting/welding5; SCARA electronics4. Added2/3DOF gantry/mobile support improves reach/flexibility; >6DOF redundancy aids obstacles.

Kinematics ignores causal forces; includes position,velocity,acceleration,higher derivatives with time or other variables, geometry and timing. Nearly rigid links permit neighboring relative motion through joints.

pages.observations: Dynamics studies forces causing motion; accelerating/cruising/decelerating require torque functions. Torque depends on spatial/temporal path, link/payload mass and friction; dynamic equations supply torque functions.

Inverse dynamics computes torque for desired motion. Direct dynamics simulation finds acceleration from torque then displacement. Diagram labels joint torques and end-effector V/A. No statement here says testing controllers without a robot.

A-to-B end-effector movement requires a trajectory for each joint. Common synchronized starts/ends coordinate motion; intermediate via points constrain route. Drawing shows changed theta1..3 at two tool poses. No smooth-polynomial or Cartesian/joint-space comparison is present.

pages.observations: Programming language interfaces human and robot; flexible means programmable rather than physically compliant. Offline graphics environment permits developing programs without the robot.
